Taiwan Builds a “Drone Hellscape” to Deter China

Taiwan is rapidly expanding its drone capabilities as part of a strategy to make a potential Chinese invasion extremely costly.

The island aims to produce 100,000 drones per month by 2030, including aerial and maritime systems.
